g.text: Search the library catalog, reserve a copy for pickup and keep track of
Find the title in the catalog
Search by title, author or ISBN. Each book shows how many
copies are available and its shelf location.
If a copy is in, Reserve for Pickup holds it for you until the
pickup date shown. If every copy is out, reserving puts you in
the queue and shows your position.
Borrow and return at the circulation desk
Checkout is not done online. Show the library card from your
dashboard at the desk and staff scan it to lend you the book.
Bring the book back to the desk to return it.
Your STI College Alabang Microsoft account, the one ending
Can I reserve books right after my first sign-in?
Not yet. You complete your profile first, then show your school ID at the library
circulation desk so the librarian can activate your account.
Where do I check a reservation or a due date?
On your dashboard. Reservations shows Ready for Pickup or your queue
position, and Current Borrows shows when each book is due. Past loans are

How do I borrow a book?
Open the catalog, find a title, then present your digital library card QR at the circulation desk for checkout.
What if the catalog says available but I cannot find it?
Open the book details and use the report action. The librarian queue will be notified for shelf verification.
Can I use the card on my phone only?
Yes. The QR on your digital card is valid. You can also export a copy from the My Card page if needed.
Where can I see my current borrows?
Use My Borrowing from the dashboard quick actions to review active and past borrowing records.
05-student-card-back — Digital Library Card — Back / QR View (/dashboard)
Present this card every time you borrow books and other library materials.
Surrender this card at the end of the semester for clearance.
